thread:
deploybot: [AUTO-HOLD] Release v3.14.0 -> production paused due to incident ingress-503s in us-west-1. Canary failure rate > 5%. Release slot 14:00-15:00 PST auto-held. Use /release status for details.
jamie_ops: Saw the alert. Ops running limited flush, we have increased ingress replicas. Any ETA on stabilization?
chris_eng: Investigating root cause - we see a middleware throttling loop when KV cache warms. Rolling back recent proxy tweak in canary.
raj_sre: If canary rollback succeeds, do we want to unhold? Need explicit pin/rollforward decision.
sophia_pm: Product prefers to avoid rollback if possible, but customers are affected. If rollback safe, unhold; else reschedule release to Tuesday change window.
chris_eng: Rollback now in canary -> ok patch applied. Monitoring metrics...
deploybot: Canary health restored. However, policy requires manual approval to resume a held release after incident.
jamie_ops: I'd prefer we pin current prod version and reschedule the feature release to the next weekend window. Less risky.
chris_eng: Agree with pin. We can pin to v3.13.9 and open a backfill release for 3.14.0 after more testing. I'll prepare rollback notes.
sophia_pm: OK — pin + reschedule. Please draft release note about deferral and planned canary retest.
deploybot: Action items: 1) ops to confirm pin -> /release pin v3.13.9 2) eng to prepare 3.14.0 postmortem + CI perf test 3) release-manager to reschedule slot. Use @release-manager to confirm.
chris_eng: Pin issued locally, sending command now:
```
/release pin --version v3.13.9 --reason "incident ingress-503s canary failures"
```
Will follow up with PR link.
deploybot: Pin recorded. Release v3.14.0 marked 'deferred'. New hold ticket: #INC-2098.
release_manager: Got it. Rescheduling to Saturday 02:00 UTC maintenance window. Will notify stakeholders and update release calendar.
jamie_ops: Ops confirms no further action required in prod; monitoring for 30m then close incident.
raj_sre: Suggest adding a canary extended soak for 2 hours next try and enable KV cache warm-up step earlier in pipeline.
sophia_pm: Noted. I'll update the rollout playbook and release notes draft.
chris_eng: Adding a regression test that covers the proxy warm path. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321
deploybot: Notifying channels: #eng-releases, #customer-success, #statuspage. If anyone needs escalation, ping @cto on-call.
jamie_ops: :thumbsup: Thanks all. Will post a short customer-facing blurb once release_manager confirms exact time.
release_manager: Blurb drafted and scheduled for 15:30 PST. Closing thread after monitoring window.
